about: Real pydantic-ai spans: pydantic-ai instruments itself (no OpenInference), with its default settings, so agent-run spans carry their usage under gen_ai.aggregated_usage.*. Agents run OpenAIChatModel against a scripted OpenAI through an in-process httpx2 mock transport: no network, no API keys, no rius SDK. pydantic-ai measures time to first chunk with time.perf_counter() and writes it into a span attribute; the recorder replaces that clock with one that advances 1 ms per reading so the value is identical across runs.
record: python record.py <recording.json> <environment.json>, in a virtualenv holding exactly the pins below

scenarios.chat: Agent.run_sync with a system prompt, temperature and max_tokens: an invoke_agent span and a chat span.
scenarios.agent_tools: An agent with one tool: chat (tool call), execute_tool, chat (answer) under one invoke_agent span; usage on each chat span and summed on the agent span.
scenarios.error: The provider answers 400 (model_not_found): both the agent and the chat span end ERROR with an exception event.
